01:19 - Mark: that 99.95 number — is that contractual SLA or aspirational?
01:23 - Priya: it's contractual for Dedicated with the enterprise add-on. for hosted API customers default is 99.9. backups, autoscaling, and fallback routing to other regions are part of the Dedicated playbook to hit 99.95.
01:34 - Mark: ok we'll need that in the SLA section of the MSA, and defined credits if you miss the target.
01:40 - Ethan: yes, service credits are standard; Marta will attach SLA language.

01:59 - Omar: we need encryption keys in our KMS — we can't share plaintext keys. is KMS integration available?
02:05 - Priya: yes, we support customer-managed keys (CMK) with KMS/HSM integrations. there's a private deployment option where your keys stay in your cloud account; for hosted, we also offer bring-your-own-key (BYOK) via a KMS integration.
02:17 - Omar: good, also SSO — we'll need SAML-based SSO with SCIM for provisioning.

02:59 - Marta: yes i'll prepare a redline that limits liability to the annual committed fees and clarifies model output disclaimers.
03:05 - Mark: also data deletion — we want a 30-day window to confirm deletion after termination and a certification.
03:11 - Marta: we can provide attestation for deletion within 30 days for production data; backups may take slightly longer but we'll provide a schedule.

04:21 - Mark: indemnity and insurance — we need to see certificate of insurance and limits.

04:49 - Lisa: ha, ok. i've flagged a couple of redlines in the DPA around sub-processor notice periods — we want 30 days notice for any new sub-processor.
04:57 - Marta: we usually do 30 days for material sub-processors; we can confirm that in the DPA.
05:01 - Omar: one technical detail — audit log format and how long keys are rotated. do you rotate keys automatically if we use your KMS or is that customer controlled?
05:09 - Priya: if you bring your own keys, key rotation is under your control. if we manage keys we rotate per our schedule but can align with customer controls via contract. audit logs are JSON lines; retention configurable.
05:19 - Mark: can we get sample log schema?
